metadata.disclaimer: DETERMINISTIC PLACEHOLDER DATA - NOT EXPERIMENTAL MEASUREMENTS. The interaction scores in this Neuro-SLI matrix are deterministic placeholder values derived from pathway-overlap heuristics and established DDR biology (same-pathway gene pairs -> buffering; cross-pathway pairs where BOTH pathways are core DDR-repair -> synthetic lethal; otherwise neutral). They are NOT measured genetic interactions and have no wet-lab validation. The real Neuro-SLI matrix will be generated by the Phase 3 wet-lab Cas12a combinatorial knockout screen (12-18 months, scoped in the Neuroprotection Knowledge Graph Build Plan, Chapter 3), which has NOT yet been run. Treat every prediction built on this matrix as a hypothesis-generating scaffold, not a clinical or experimental claim.
